tasks.goal: Codedoc start rejects unsafe feature names and invalid code paths before any workspace path is constructed or a 202 response is returned.

inputs.name: feature_name
inputs.constraints: must be a safe slug with no path separators or traversal segments

inputs.name: code_path
inputs.constraints: must exist and resolve to a directory

outputs.name: validated_request
outputs.constraints: invalid input returns 4xx without creating workspace files

outputs.name: safe_workspace_paths
outputs.constraints: all codedoc paths stay under workspace/codedoc/<feature>

acceptance: POST /api/codedoc/start with feature_name ../escape returns 400 and does not create files outside workspace/codedoc
POST /api/codedoc/start with a missing code_path returns 400
POST /api/codedoc/start with a file code_path returns 400
Valid codedoc start requests still return 202
go test ./internal/api ./internal/codedoc -run 'TestCodedocHandlers|TestOrchestrator' passes for input validation cases
constraints: Do not rely on UI-only validation
Reject unsafe input before any goroutine launch

tasks.task_name: Make codedoc start durable and resumable
tasks.goal: Codedoc start persists initial workflow state before returning, detects persisted conflicts after restart, and allows gate actions to resume workflows instead of failing on missing in-memory orchestrators.

inputs.name: persisted_state
inputs.constraints: may exist from a prior run or restart

outputs.name: durable_start
outputs.constraints: initial state exists on disk before async execution proceeds

acceptance: Starting a codedoc workflow creates the state directory and workflow-state.json before the background transition begins
Starting a codedoc workflow with an existing persisted feature returns conflict or resume guidance instead of overwriting state
A codedoc scope gate action succeeds after server restart when persisted state exists
A codedoc final gate action succeeds after server restart when persisted state exists
go test ./internal/api ./internal/codedoc passes for durable start and resume scenarios
constraints: Do not require manual re-registration of workflows after restart
Avoid breaking existing in-memory fast path

tasks.goal: Holdout generation dispatch produces validated JSON and markdown artifacts per round, and invalid or missing holdout outputs fail the stage instead of being treated as success.

inputs.name: spec_input
inputs.constraints: current spec exists for the active round

outputs.name: holdout_json
outputs.constraints: validates against HoldoutOutput schema for the active round

outputs.name: holdout_markdown
outputs.constraints: exists and is referenced by the validated JSON output

acceptance: Holdout generation uses a single structured prompt builder rather than an ad hoc inline prompt string
A successful holdout run writes holdout-round-{N}.json and holdouts-round-{N}.md
Missing holdouts-round-{N}.md causes the stage to fail
Invalid holdout-round-{N}.json causes the stage to fail
go test ./internal/specworkflow -run 'Test.*Holdout' passes with contract validation coverage

depends_on.reason: Independent of codedoc hardening and blocks correct holdout behavior

constraints: Preserve legacy workflows that do not yet have round holdouts
Use existing HoldoutOutput schema as the validation boundary or update it alongside callers

tasks.task_name: Integrate holdouts into review, revise, finalize, and UI flow
tasks.goal: Round holdouts affect reviewer inputs, reviser filtering, finalization output, and dashboard stage rendering in the way described by the holdout spec.

inputs.name: round_holdouts
inputs.constraints: latest holdouts-round-{N}.md may exist after holdout generation

inputs.name: merged_findings
inputs.constraints: must distinguish spec-targeted from holdout-targeted findings

outputs.name: targeted_findings
outputs.constraints: each finding carries target=spec or target=holdout

outputs.name: aligned_pipeline_ui
outputs.constraints: stepper includes holdout stage between review and revise

acceptance: Reviewer prompts in round 2+ include the latest round holdout path
Reviser prompts exclude holdout-targeted findings and never receive holdout files
Finalization uses holdouts-round-{N}.md when present and falls back to the legacy holdout file otherwise
The dashboard stepper shows a Holdout stage between Review and Revise
go test ./internal/specworkflow and relevant frontend/manual verification cover the updated flow
constraints: Do not leak holdout content into reviser prompts
Keep legacy finalization fallback until old workspaces are migrated

tasks.task_name: Normalize shared workflow API and UI contracts
tasks.goal: Workspace overrides, reset actions, startup config requirements, and gate payloads behave consistently across spec workflow, code review, and codedoc.

inputs.name: api_requests
inputs.constraints: workspace_dir and reset actions differ by workflow type today

inputs.name: server_config
inputs.constraints: default startup must either be valid or fail clearly at boot

outputs.name: consistent_api_contract
outputs.constraints: supported fields are handled uniformly or rejected explicitly

outputs.name: accurate_gate_payloads
outputs.constraints: final gate fields reflect real unresolved counts and drift warnings

acceptance: Spec workflow workspace overrides are applied before runner construction and source-doc copying
Code review workspace overrides are either fully supported end to end or rejected explicitly
Codedoc workspace_dir is either implemented server-side or removed from the UI payload
Terminal reset buttons call the correct endpoint for each workflow type
Starting the server without required spec skill templates fails early with a clear error or uses valid defaults
Codedoc final gate payload reports real unresolved counts and drift warning values
Unused codedoc gate comment wiring is either removed or transmitted and persisted

depends_on.reason: Cross-cutting workflow cleanup can proceed in parallel with holdout work

constraints: Prefer explicit rejection over silent field dropping
Do not preserve misleading UI affordances

tasks.task_name: Add regression coverage for audited failure paths
tasks.goal: Automated tests fail on the audited wiring regressions and pass only when the security, holdout, lifecycle, and UI contract issues are corrected.

inputs.name: audit_findings
inputs.constraints: security, holdout, lifecycle, and workflow contract failures

outputs.name: regression_tests
outputs.type: Go tests and existing UI verification notes

acceptance: A traversal attempt in codedoc start is covered by an automated test
Codedoc durable start and resume-after-restart gate handling are covered by automated tests
Holdout artifact validation and downstream consumption are covered by automated tests
Workflow contract tests cover reset endpoint selection and workspace override behavior where server-side logic exists
go test ./... passes
constraints: Prefer integration tests for handler/orchestrator boundaries where the bugs manifested
Do not close remediation while go test ./... is red
